title: KestrelCare Accounts Payable Terms: Repair Payment Amount
content:
**Term.** The repair payment to a facility on an approved KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts decision is the amount the decision approved, never above the coverage remaining on the plan when the payment is made, rounded to the cent.

- **Approved amount:** the amount payable on the plan's approved claim decision entry being paid.
- **Coverage remaining:** the figure the plan shows at the moment the payment is made, not the figure it showed on the decision date.
- **Rounding:** once, to the cent, on the final figure.

| Approved amount | Coverage remaining when paid | Repair payment |
|---|---|---|
| 2400.00 | 9100.00 | 2400.00 |
| 2400.00 | 1975.40 | 1975.40 |
| 0.00 | any | 0.00 |

*The figures in the table are hypothetical.* In the second row the plan no longer holds the approved amount, so the payment is held to what it does hold.
